lines.en: My boots beat a hard rhythm
I press along the wall
The red ribbon sways on my arm
I close in without slowing
I step over fallen stone
I run with my body low
I clench my fist and release
I swing in a wide arc around you
My shadow comes straight at you
My boots crunch broken tiles
I raise my head to find you
I come in low across the ground
I work my knuckles
I roll my sleeve up
I stand with a straight back
I stare at the badge in my hand
I wait here for orders
I roll my neck
My boot taps the ground
I straighten my collar
I hop twice in place
I am not used to standing by
I tighten my wrist guard
I look at the smoke far off

lines.zh: 我低声报了自己的番号
lines.en: I mutter my unit number
I size you up and down
You are not on my list
The Red Ribbon Army is working

lines.zh: 红缎带的靴子，站得太近了。
lines.en: Red Ribbon boots standing much too close.
Light sits under my brow
The ki around you is weak
Let me confirm who you are
Keep your hands where I see them
Do you want to test me
I lift my chin and ask
This ground is mine to hold
Step back three paces to talk
I smooth my glove
I can see you calculating
You carry no orders
I let out a grunt
My boots skid a line
I wipe the corner of my mouth
I push my weight back down
I set my teeth hard
My wrist guard has split
I take one rough breath
This injury will not stop me
I steady myself and go on
On duty, I do not eat
Take that food away
I do not bow for a meal
That trick will not work on me
I raise a hand and refuse
My rations are in my pouch
You cannot buy me
We eat after the fighting
I smell it, and I decline
Do not wave food in my face
You ran into my shoulder
My heels stay planted
We collide with a dull thud
I do not even blink
Hitting me is hitting iron
I drop my shoulder and hold
Back off, do not crowd me
Consider that your test
I push you clear with one hand
I do not discuss such matters
That is not in my orders
The army has all my hours
I have no time for that
She is not in the ranks either
I will speak of it after the war
I shake my head and turn away
Such matters come after the mission
I think only of the next fight
I pick up a fallen badge
These papers are mine
I tuck it inside my coat
I pick up a spent shell
I stoop for my belt
This has to be handed in
I will pass it to supply
I weigh it and pocket it
That is not me hoarding it
I put it back where it was
You are in my sight now
I mark you as the target
This distance is close enough
I load my legs
Turning will not save you
I handle this one myself
My orders permit this
I have your balance marked
Do not try to get behind me
My fist is coming up
I have your ki now
I clear this area
I take the straight line
You are inside my striking range
I need no backup
I have eyes only for you
I close the gap step by step

lines.zh: 你后退的方向我算好了
lines.en: I have your retreat mapped
Your left shoulder moves first
I wait for your punch first
No hurry, I plant my feet first
I follow your every motion
Back to the wall and you are done
I raise my elbow to guard my ribs
Your weight sits left
I am waiting for a mistake
There is no cover here
You are faster, not faster enough
My pace never changes
I count how often you swing
Your punches are slowing
I can press in whenever

lines.zh: 你听得到我靴子的声音
lines.en: You hear my boots coming
My fist lands on your chest
My elbow drives at your jaw
My boot catches your knee
A straight punch goes down the middle
My shoulder rams your chest
You block, and your arm goes numb
I follow with another fist
This one comes from the hips
I shove you backwards
My knee finds your stomach
I slip your punch aside
My palm slaps your shoulder
I strike the edge of your armor
You need two steps to stop
I switch hands and hit again
I walk out of the dust
My boots land before I do
The red ribbon snaps in the wind
My orders have come through
I straighten my collar
I set myself on the ground
Reporting as ordered
I raise my fist to my chest
This area is now a combat zone
I come around the wall
I pull my gloves tight
The wind flattens my coat
I glance up at the sky
I step into the open ground
My side is in position
I state my name aloud
Dust circles my ankles
The mission starts now
Flame licks my forearm

lines.zh: 落地时我单膝跪了一下
lines.en: I land on one knee
Water fills my lungs and holds me
The blast shoves me backwards
A round grazes my shoulder
Magic scatters my ki
Unfed, my fists feel hollow
The strike buckles my leg
Falling, I clench my fist
